title: Item reference
description: Identifies a catalogue entry — a blueprint product, an item, a material or a ship type. The server resolves the first field it can, in the order bt, scRecord, scGuid, uexId, locKey, name.

bt.description: The Basetool's own key. Always wins when present.

scRecord.description: DataForge record name (scmdb `tag`), compared case-insensitively. Not unique in the catalogue, so it can resolve `ambiguous`.

scGuid.description: Game entity GUID, matched against blueprint records and output items; duplicates resolve `ambiguous`.

locKey.description: The name key from the game's global.ini, without the leading @. Language-independent.

name.description: Display name as the game shows it.

nameLocale.description: Language of `name`, e.g. `en` or `de-DE`. Defaults to `en`.
